parts:
Dear all,

some of you have volunteered to read a chapter or two of our upcoming AHM2 book. Academic Press have just informed us that the first batches of the proofs will come in late December. Hence, we will send out some chapters to you when they come in and would expect a turnaround within one week. Of course, if you no longer have time, then we totally understand.

( Sorry for this slight abuse of the unmarked and HMecology lists. )

Best regards  ----  Marc
